name: astro-blog
description: Blog platform: static site with Keystatic CMS (website/: Astro + Keystatic), admin app (admin/: React + Vite) and API (server/: NestJS) for likes, shares, mailing list and feedback. This root only orchestrates the three independent pnpm projects.

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --dir server install && pnpm --dir admin install && pnpm --dir website install
scripts.build: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:web
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:admin && pnpm run check:web
scripts.sdk: pnpm --dir server run build && pnpm --dir server run openapi ../admin/openapi.json && pnpm --dir admin run sdk
scripts.docker:build: pnpm run docker:build:api && pnpm run docker:build:admin && pnpm run docker:build:web
